keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «톰이 아주 외로워한다(마음)» 와 «사랑하는 사람들이 나를 봐 주는 것이 가장 좋다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the feeling (Tom feels very lonely) and the lesson (being seen by the people you love is the best). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Tom feels very lonely because nobody can see him.
Being seen by the people you love is the best.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

evs: But at lunch, his friends play without him.
He takes cookies, and nobody knows.
The next morning, everyone can see Tom again.
why: «But at lunch, his friends play without him.» 아무도 톰을 볼 수 없어서 친구들이 톰 없이 놀아요. 혼자가 되니 외로워요.
Nobody can see Tom, so his friends play without him. That is why Tom feels lonely.

qs.q: "Poof! He is invisible!" What does "invisible" mean?
qs.qko: «He is invisible!» 에서 «invisible» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: Tom drinks a strange blue juice.
why: «Nobody can see him.» 아무도 톰을 볼 수 없어요. 그러니 «invisible» 은 «눈에 보이지 않는» 이라는 뜻이에요.
Nobody can see him. So "invisible" means not able to be seen.

qs.q: Why can’t Mom give Tom a hug?
qs.qko: 엄마는 왜 톰을 안아 줄 수 없나요?
opts: Tom is invisible, so Mom cannot find him.
Tom is at school all day.
evs: At home, Mom cannot find him to give him a hug.
The next morning, everyone can see Tom again.
why: 아무도 톰을 볼 수 없어서(«Nobody can see him.») 엄마가 톰을 찾지 못해 안아 줄 수 없어요(«At home, Mom cannot find him to give him a hug.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Nobody can see Tom, so Mom cannot find him to give him a hug. You need both sentences.

ends: Tom gives Mom a big hug and plays with his friends.
톰은 엄마를 꼭 안아 주고 친구들과 함께 논다.
Tom pours the blue juice away so he will not be invisible again.
톰은 다시는 투명해지지 않도록 파란 주스를 버린다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Tom is happy now</u> because <u>everyone can see him again</u>.”

img.cover: In a cozy kitchen, a boy with short black hair in a red hoodie and blue jeans finishes a glass of strange glowing blue juice, and with a big puff of blue sparkles his body starts to turn see-through from his feet up.

scenes.1: On a sunny school playground, a group of friends play ball together, while a faint, see-through outline of a boy with short black hair in a red hoodie and blue jeans stands alone at the side holding a cookie and looking sad.
scenes.2: In a bright home in the morning, a boy with short black hair in a red hoodie and blue jeans can be seen clearly again, and Mom gives him a big warm hug while two of his friends wave happily at the door.

alt.1: Invisible Tom stands alone while his friends play.
alt.2: Mom hugs Tom when everyone can see him again.
alt.cover: Tom drinks blue juice and starts to disappear.
